title: Tiny, cute lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='55%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7c0'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffdd55'/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color='#ffaa22'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M38 22 Q38 8 50 8 Q62 8 62 22' fill='none' stroke='#c08030' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- top cap -->
  <rect x='34' y='22' width='32' height='7' rx='3' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <rect x='40' y='20' width='20' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a86a33'/>

  <!-- glass body -->
  <rect x='36' y='29' width='28' height='42' rx='6' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <rect x='36' y='29' width='28' height='42' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#66ccff' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- flame -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#ff8822'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='3.5' ry='7' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='1.8' ry='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- wick -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='58' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#7a4a1a'/>

  <!-- side bars -->
  <rect x='32' y='31' width='4' height='38' rx='2' fill='#a86a33'/>
  <rect x='64' y='31' width='4' height='38' rx='2' fill='#a86a33'/>

  <!-- bottom cap -->
  <rect x='34' y='69' width='32' height='8' rx='3' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <rect x='40' y='77' width='20' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a86a33'/>

  <!-- little feet -->
  <rect x='42' y='81' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <rect x='52' y='81' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8b5a2b'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='40' r='2' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#ffdd55' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='62' r='1.5' fill='#ffdd55' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='34' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
